title: ecg-glucose-benchmark: analysis code, pre-specified protocols and aggregate results for detecting hypo- and hyperglycemia from inpatient 12-lead ECGs
description:
Analysis code, aggregate results and analysis-plan excerpt for a study of hypoglycemia and severe hyperglycemia detection from inpatient 12-lead ECGs in MIMIC-IV-Ext-ECG-Glucose v1.0.0, with waveforms from MIMIC-IV-ECG v1.0, and of pretraining contamination of ECG foundation models. Models: demographics, ECG machine measurements, a 1-D CNN trained from scratch, and frozen ECG foundation models with an L2 logistic probe (ECGFounder and ECG-JEPA, pretrained without MIMIC-IV-ECG; ECG-FM pretrained and fine-tuned, both trained on part of MIMIC-IV-ECG).

Version 1.1.0 pre-registered a confirmatory replication (plan step 15) on 416,503 MIMIC-IV-ECG recordings outside the glucose cohort; it was run once and both rules passed (note 17). Version 1.2.0 adds that result, a direct pretraining-membership check (plan step 16: ECG-FM's own contrastive loss on 22,058 unseen against 22,058 seen patients; recorded in a dated private commit before its code; rule M1 not met, note 18), and pre-registers a continued-pretraining positive control (plan step 17): ECG-FM's self-supervised pretraining is continued for four epochs on all recordings of a random half of the unseen patients, creating known members. Rules: the loss check detects the injected half (K1); the injected-minus-held-out AUROC gap of the continued model exceeds the original model's on LVH (P1) and on the mean of four labelled statements (P2); the comparator's gap contains zero (N0). Version 1.3.0 adds that result (note 19: N0 passed; K1, P1 and P2 not met) and pre-registers a calibrated audit (plan step 18): (a) a paired manipulation check on the unseen patients, comparing the continued and the original model on the same recording, with rules K2 (loss) and C2 (segment agreement); (b) a segment-agreement placebo on ECGFounder and ECG-JEPA, which never saw MIMIC-IV-ECG, with rule M2: the seen-minus-unseen standardised difference of ECG-FM exceeds that of each clean model. Version 1.4.0 adds that result (note 20: K2 not met, C2 not met narrowly, M2 passed) and pre-registers plan step 19: on fresh glucose-cohort recordings from patients outside step 16, the segment-agreement trace of ECG-FM against ECG-JEPA, ECGFounder and ECG-FM with permuted weights (rule M3); dataset inference from the stored embeddings with a Gaussian-mixture density fitted on a separate seen set (rule D1); and the paired loss check repeated with the same masks and negatives for both checkpoints (rule K3). Version 1.5.0 adds that result (note 21: M3 and D1 not met, K3 passed) and a post hoc re-reading with the same eligibility rule for seen and unseen patients (plan step 20, recorded with its code before its run; note 22: groups balanced, M3* passed, D1* not met), and pre-registers plan step 21: the pretraining DiD of ECG-FM against ECG-JEPA on six ECG-FM fine-tuning labels not scored before (infarction, premature ventricular contraction, atrial flutter, electronic pacemaker, poor data quality, sinus rhythm), on the 416,503 replication recordings; the primary family is the tasks whose out-of-fold ECG-JEPA AUROC is at most 0.95; gate G21 (fine-tuned positive control's mean DiD lower bound above 0) and test H21 (pretrained ECG-FM's mean DiD read with margin 0.01); step 21 is declared the last analysis of the membership effect. Protocol and code (glukosa_lepas_plafon/) are released before any model is scored on these tasks.

No data from the credentialed dataset are included: the scripts run locally on the PhysioNet releases and print aggregate tables only, with counts between 1 and 10 masked. Code: MIT. Notes and plan excerpt: CC BY 4.0.
